Fetch, build and install both versions

Source: R/prepare.R
prepare_versions.Rd

Installs the baseline and the candidate into their own libraries in the work folder (lib-base, lib-cand), byte-compiled from source tarballs as users get them, and records their provenance in versions.json: the tarball's sha256, its Packaged, Repository and Date/Publication fields, the git commit, and optionally whether the baseline's R/ matches a release tag.

Usage

prepare_versions(d, force = FALSE, ask = interactive(), quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

d

A dossier().

force

Reinstall both versions even when they look unchanged.

ask

Ask before downloading from CRAN.

quiet

Suppress progress messages.

Value

The provenance of both versions, invisibly (a list with elements base and cand).

Details

CRAN sources are downloaded here and nowhere else; the function says what it downloads and where first, and asks when ask is TRUE. Git sources are exported with git archive and built with R CMD build inside the work folder.

A version whose source has not changed since the last call (same tarball checksum, same commit, same folder contents, or the same CRAN version) is not reinstalled unless force = TRUE, so re-running after a fix rebuilds only the candidate. For cran_release() every call reads CRAN's package index to find the current version, so a new release is picked up; if the index cannot be read, an installed copy is reused and the function says so.

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
vers <- prepare_versions(d)
#> base: tarball /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/pkgdossier/extdata/udfixture_1.0.0.tar.gz unchanged, reusing the installed copy
#> cand: tarball /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/pkgdossier/extdata/udfixture_1.1.0.tar.gz unchanged, reusing the installed copy
#> base udfixture 1.0.0  sha256 fd0de4ff9fef  packaged 2026-11-06 15:33:45 UTC; root
#> cand udfixture 1.1.0  sha256 0eaefa1ba295  packaged 2026-11-06 15:33:45 UTC; root
vers$cand$version
#> [1] "1.1.0"
# }
